campaign.title: Nova Stars
campaign.summary: Help Aurora Harbor rebuild with interstellar-themed workshops and accessible learning spaces

story.text: Aurora Harbor's learning center was damaged in a synthetic storm, leaving the community without a hub for education and growth. Nova Reed's initiative aims to rebuild the center with essential resources like books, study tables, and accessible lighting, fostering a nurturing environment for interstellar learners to thrive and explore.
story.heading: The Need

story.text: Nova Reed's plan includes new books, study tables, accessible lighting, and shared workshops to revive the center.
story.heading: Our Plan

story.text: Your support will provide a welcoming environment for learning, empowering the community to thrive and reach new heights.
story.heading: Your Impact
